capabilities: Converts reserved punctuation to fullwidth forms on paste
Handles pastes into inline note title, pane title and file list rename field
Replaces selected text like a normal paste
Leaves note bodies, letters, numbers and existing file names unchanged
extras: Bilingual English/Chinese README; main.js is readable source with no build step; MIT license.
problem: Pasting text containing characters Windows forbids in file names (: * ? " < > | / \) into Obsidian's title or rename fields produces invalid names.
summary: Paste-time converter that replaces Windows-reserved punctuation in file names with visually similar fullwidth characters.
